items.q: The scale factor is 3 and the original side is 5. Find the new side.
hints: Multiply the original length by the scale factor.

items.q: Similar triangles have corresponding sides 4 and 10. Find the scale factor.
hints: Scale factor = new length / original length.

items.q: If the scale factor from small to large is 1.5 and the small length is 12, find the large length.
hints: Multiply the original length by the scale factor.

items.q: A model is built at scale factor 4 from a shape with side 7 cm. Find the model side.
hints: Multiply the original length by the scale factor.

items.q: The scale factor from large to small is 1/3 and the large length is 27. Find the small length.
hints: Multiply the original length by the scale factor.

items.q: A shape is enlarged by factor 2.2. A side is 15 cm. Find the new side.
hints: Multiply the original length by the scale factor.

items.q: Two similar shapes have corresponding sides 6 and 15. A third side on the small shape is 8. Find the corresponding side on the large shape.
items.imageAlt: Two similar triangles. Small triangle sides 6 and 8; large triangle corresponding side 15 and unknown side x.
items.imageCaption: The two triangles are similar. Diagram not to scale.
hints: Find the scale factor from the known pair of corresponding sides, then apply it to the third length.
Scale factor = 15/6 = 2.5, so 8 x 2.5.

items.q: The linear scale factor is 3. Find the area scale factor.
items.imageAlt: Two similar squares, side 1 and side 3, linear scale factor 3. The area scale factor is unknown.
items.imageCaption: Linear scale factor 3. Diagram not to scale.
hints: The area scale factor is the linear scale factor squared.

items.q: The area of a small shape is 20 and the linear scale factor is 2.5. Find the large area.
hints: Multiply the area by the linear scale factor squared.

items.q: Find the area ratio if the linear ratio is 4:7.
hints: Square each part of the linear ratio to get the area ratio.

items.q: The linear scale factor is 5. Find the area scale factor.
hints: The area scale factor is the linear scale factor squared.

items.q: The area of a shape is 12 and the linear scale factor is 4. Find the new area.
hints: Multiply the area by the linear scale factor squared.

items.q: Find the area ratio if the linear ratio is 3:8.
hints: Square each part of the linear ratio to get the area ratio.

items.q: The area ratio of two similar shapes is 25:64. Find the linear ratio.
hints: Take the square root of each part of the area ratio to get the linear ratio.
sqrt(25) : sqrt(64).

items.q: The linear scale factor is 2. Find the volume scale factor.
hints: The volume scale factor is the linear scale factor cubed.

items.q: A small volume is 30 cm^3 and the linear scale factor is 3. Find the large volume.
hints: Multiply the volume by the linear scale factor cubed.

items.q: Find the volume ratio if the linear ratio is 2:5.
hints: Cube each part of the linear ratio to get the volume ratio.

items.q: The linear scale factor is 4. Find the volume scale factor.
hints: The volume scale factor is the linear scale factor cubed.

items.q: A cone has volume 15 cm^3 and is enlarged by factor 2. Find the new volume.
hints: Multiply the volume by the linear scale factor cubed.

items.q: Find the volume ratio if the linear ratio is 3:7.
hints: Cube each part of the linear ratio to get the volume ratio.

items.q: The volume ratio of two similar shapes is 27:125. Find the linear ratio.
hints: Take the cube root of each part of the volume ratio to get the linear ratio.
cube root of 27 : cube root of 125.
